verdict.rationale: Elicit is built around search over scholarly literature, not the open web. Its documentation describes semantic search across 138M+ academic papers, keyword and Boolean search, and journal and citation filters. Clinical trial registry search and agent sourcing from publications, public filings and press releases cover primary sources. A browser extension retrieves paywalled full text through the user's institutional access, and one hands-on user got cited papers back quickly. Missing for 10: the source corpora behind the paper index are not documented; community reports of missed key papers and of paywalled research being absent leave coverage completeness unproven.
